title: Keep pools to the pool safety standard
what: Keep each regulated pool compliant with the pool safety standard and its barriers in good condition.

sources.title: Building Act 1975 (Qld)
sources.quote: The owner of a regulated pool must ensure— (a) the pool complies with the pool safety standard for the pool; and (b) all barriers for the pool are kept in good condition
